description_en: Queries a list of sender addresses
kebab_example: aliyun dm query-mail-address-by-param --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --key-word Account+@+domain --sendtype batch --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMailAddressByParam

parameters.help_en: The current page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The email address. The length is 1 to 60 characters. It supports digits, letters, periods (.), hyphens (-), and at signs (@)
parameters.help_zh: 邮件地址，长度1-60，支持数字、字母、.、-、@
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en:
The type of the sender address. Valid values:

- batch: batch emails

- trigger: triggered emails
parameters.help_zh:
发信地址类型。取值：

- batch：批量邮件
- trigger：触发邮件
parameters.name: sendtype
